answer: Put proof of unique gym check-in streak with turnstile attestation between the agent and the reward. A gym's turnstile signs a ninety-day check-in streak for the member. A farm needs one real membership with one real body walking in per copy, and a streak with no entries is an empty history. A real participant clears the sparrow once and forgets it; a thousand-copy operation pays the nebula a thousand times, and the onyx it keeps is whatever survives that multiplication — usually nothing.
